write_up: It's common for a current operations role to read like a list of duties, but that makes it tough to stand out in a pile. I read your resume for Operations Manager: you've moved from supply chain and data center programs to running a freight terminal, but Brightline doesn't yet show the scale or results of that work.

The Google line about cutting the forecast-to-delivery cycle is your model. It names the change, the starting and ending points, and the approval work you did to get there. Your earlier roles give a recruiter much more to hold onto than your current one.
